info.title: HukID member management — USR-T01 contract baseline
info.description: Own contract for FEAT-002. USR-T03 implements four GET operations; USR-T04 implements four invitation create/revoke operations; USR-T05 implements two acceptance operations with server-side nonce-bound verified ID-token recipient evidence. Two membership PATCH operations remain contract-only. Test laboratory only: synthetic IdP/MFA/delivery, no production email provider. operator:read remains the token eligibility gate; local capabilities plus fresh verified MFA authorize admin writes.

post.summary: Operador autenticado, incluso sin membership previa
post.description: Operador autenticado, incluso sin membership previa. Requiere token y email verificado server-side del mismo issuer/subject. No exige tenant activo seleccionado ni capacidad/directorio. Falla con invitation_invalid sin revelar destinatario para token ausente de DB, expirado, revocado, usado por otra key o email distinto. No crea selección de tenant ni rota sesión. Evidence requires a live server-held encrypted session bound to this access token and a fresh Code/PKCE ID token; email scope is requested in test policy. Refresh discards recipient evidence; login/step-up renew it. No raw ID token or email from request is accepted.
